correctness.rationale: The exact multiplier conjugation identifies the iterate. For each exterior degree j, the unique least monomial-index tuple dominates in Hilbert–Schmidt norm and gives the Gram determinant D_j; ratios of successive wedge norms rigorously prove all fixed-rank limits. Jensen and explicit reversed-exponential trial polynomials prove 1<c_j and c_j down to 1. Independent direct finite matrix computations corroborated 72 assertions, without being used as proof.

value.rationale: The entire sequence of fixed-rank optimal approximation errors of iterated nonnormal Hardy composition is governed by explicit positive finite Toeplitz determinants. The strict larger-than-eigenvalue coefficients and their monotone decay to 1 quantify spectral-vs-approximation anisotropy at every rank, a natural complete family of invariants motivated by approximation-number and iteration theory.
